Recommended Bidder: Mopal Construction Limited Contract Award Value: $2,455,510, net of all applicable taxes and charges, including Provisional Price Items $2,774,726 including HST and all applicable charges $2,498,728 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on June 29, 2019 and end by June 27, 2020.
